name: Juggernaut

abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Wither: Rakibin güç kazanma ve iyileşme etkilerini zayıflatır.
abilityDetails.Stagger: Sendeletilen (Staggered) şampiyonlar bir sonraki kazandıkları buff'ı Nullify eder.
abilityDetails.Energize: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

signatureAbility:
Gem Acclimation
The Weakness Passive from the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak is reduced to [30 - 5]% and becomes a Debuff instead.
Attacks have a [1.5 - 3]% chance per Unstoppable Buff to Nullify a Buff from the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Crimson Gem of Cyttorak
content: Juggernaut starts the fight with the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak active.
The Crimson Gem of Cyttorak is disabled if Juggernaut suffers a non-damaging Debuff or is knocked down. While the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak is disabled, Juggernaut suffers a 50% Weakness Passive.

While the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak is active, Juggernaut is empowered and gains the following:
1. +[5,084] Attack Rating.
2. +25% Damage Reduction.
3. Immunity to Reversed Controls.

abilitySections.title: Unstoppable Buffs - Max Stacks: 10
content: Juggernaut can only activate his Unstoppable Buffs if the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak is active.
Juggernaut gains 1 Unstoppable Buff each time he moves forward or lands an attack, but loses 1 Unstoppable Buff each time he is struck, enters block, or blocks an attack.
Unstoppable Buffs decrease by 1 every 1.25 seconds. This timer is reset each time an Unstoppable Buff is added or removed, or when Juggernaut Dodges backwards.

Each Unstoppable Buff provides the following:
1. +[1,016.8] Attack Rating.
2. Increases Power Rate by 2.5%.
3. Lowers the opponent's chance to trigger Stun Debuffs by 20%. If this ability prevents a Stun Debuff from triggering, Juggernaut loses 7 Unstoppable Buffs.

abilitySections.title: Maximum Momentum
content: While Juggernaut has 10 Unstoppable Buffs, he gains an Unblockable Passive making his next blocked attack Unblockable at the cost of 10 Unstoppable Buffs.

After landing a Maximum Momentum Unblockable attack, Juggernaut is unable to gain his Unstoppable Buffs for 7 seconds, and places a Wither Debuff on the Opponent reducing their Power Rate by 50% for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: 100% chance to Stagger the Opponent for 8 seconds. The next time a Staggered Opponent triggers a Buff, that Buff and all other Buffs triggered at the same time will be immediately Nullified.
If the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak is active, inflict an additional Stagger.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Activate the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak if it is disabled.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Gain an Energize Buff for 10 seconds, granting 25% increased Combat Power Rate.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit deals a burst of [5,084] Physical damage.
While at Maximum Momentum, 100% chance to gain a Fury Buff granting +[20,336] Attack Rating for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: When activated, the Crimson Gem of Cyrrotak cannot be removed for 20 seconds.
While at Maximum Momentum, inflict a Stun Debuff on the Opponent for 4 seconds.
